verdict.rationale: Riskified is a fraud-prevention SaaS with a merchant account, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask about. However, the evidence shows only automated fraud decisioning APIs, integrations and an llms.txt docs file, with no in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Automated order decisions are a different feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
